author: Ananya Kulkarni
body: Dr. Neha explained every step of my root canal and it didn't hurt at all. The clinic is spotless and the staff are so kind.

author: Rohit Sharma
body: Had a 10:30 appointment and waited almost 50 minutes. Nobody told us why. The treatment itself was fine but the waiting time is terrible.

author: Meera Joshi
body: Good cleaning, very gentle. Booking on WhatsApp was easy. A bit pricey compared to other clinics in Baner.

author: Vikram Patil
body: Got my aligners here. Clear plan with prices before we started, no surprises. Highly recommend.

author: Sana Shaikh
body: My crown came loose after a week and when I called nobody called me back. Very disappointed, thinking of going to the consumer forum.

author: Karan Mehta
body: Doctor was good but the reception was confused about my appointment time and I had to wait.

author: Priya Nair
body: Took my 6 year old for a check-up, the dentist was so patient with her. She actually wants to go back!

author: Arjun Rao
body: Quick and professional. Parking is hard to find though.
